Target language: Uzbek. It was resolved from the customer's request before this call and is final: it overrides the language the description, the sources or the outline happen to be written in. Dates and ordinals the Uzbek way: 2024-yil, 15-mart, 3-bob; decimals with a comma (3,5 foiz). Keep each term the same throughout. Avoid stock phrases ("Bugungi kunda", "Maʼlumki", "Shuni taʼkidlash joizki", "muhim ahamiyat kasb etadi", "muhim o‘rin tutadi", "katta ahamiyatga ega", "dolzarb masalalardan biri hisoblanadi", "Xulosa qilib aytganda"), do not chain sentences with "Shuningdek", "Bundan tashqari" and "Shu bilan birga", and never begin two sections the same way; do not be stiff or bureaucratic. Russian names in Uzbek Latin spelling (Pushkin, Moskva), well-known foreign names in their established Uzbek form (Shekspir, Nyuton), brand, product and organisation names as their owners write them (Google, Payme, IT Park).

input.writing_guidance: Plan 10 sections only: heading and 1–2 brief coverage sentences each. Preserve section ids. No final prose or notes. Use 3 photo layouts in this part: image_split or image_full on slides a picture supports, and the cover counts when it has an image_query. Use fewer only if the description asks for fewer or no photos. image_query names what the photo literally shows, for a stock photo search: 2-4 plain words in English, even when the deck is in another language, main subject first, a concrete thing, place or activity that matches this slide (e.g. "warehouse forklift", "students science lab"). Never an abstract idea such as success, growth or strategy; never a person, brand or company name. This call plans sections 1-10 of 12. Plan the opening of the document here. Do not plan a conclusion or a closing slide yet. Plan the required subtopics that belong in this part of the document and leave the rest to the other parts.
